**What's in 1.2.0**

- A new palette, ticket-style tarot cards and a riffle-and-flip shuffle
- Search the tarot deck by name, title, sign, lines or painter
- The deck opens as slide mounts, three across
- Only the chosen rock style says Rock
- Press D to switch between light and dark
- The calendar no longer records responses or outcomes; old records stay
- Open the Bestiary from a calendar entry
- Brighter tarot stickers
